name: Kamishiro Yuu
source:
The main character.

He is an athlete who trains day and night to become a martial artist. He has a thin frame and is admired as a beautiful girl.

Because of his cursed constitution, he is forced to attend Lilienne Girls' School dressed as a woman.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/josou/index.html]official site[/url]]
